messages:
Marta: Drafting a 1-page field brief: map deploy modes to security + SLA talking points, plus a tiny inbound routing snippet. Need quick thumbs by EOD.
Sam: Put a bold stat up top comparing SLA predictability. Exec-friendly.
Marta: Tentative: "Dedicated: 99.95% SLA; predictable p99 latency for enterprise loads." Need bench numbers.
Alex: Bench note: "Dedicated baseline (n1-highgpu) — median 120ms, p95 260ms for seq=1024 chat; hosted fallback adds ~30-50ms." Use as quote.
Marta: Which-deploy bullets:
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, usage pricing, best for trials
- Dedicated: reserved capacity, throughput + SLA, for high-volume production
- Private (VPC/on-prem): data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logging for regulated customers
Neil: Add routing guidance: route by customer tier + latency budget.
Marta: Snippet: `if customer.tier == "enterprise" and budget_ms <= 300 -> Dedicated else -> Hosted with prefix-cache`
Clara: Need two subject lines + two CTAs for A/B.
Marta: Options:
A) "SLA-backed inference for enterprise: Dedicated & Private"
B) "Stop latency surprises: pick the right deployment"
CTAs: Book a latency test; Download one-pager + checklist.
Neil: Compliance blurb OK: "Supports SOC2. Private deployments enable HIPAA-ready controls with customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit logging."
Alex: Add graceful degradation line: auto-fallback to quantized hosted variants and partial responses under pressure.
Marta: Design note: single-page PDF, left = hero + routing cheat sheet, right = bullets + next steps. Small routing flow. Send mock by tomorrow noon.
launch-bot: When final, attach to #field-assets and tag sales-enablement.
Marta: I'll post the first draft PDF by 11:00. Thanks!
